meta: AI investing apps that promise steady daily profits are almost certainly scams. 5 common warning signs:

muc.title: Promised steady profits
muc.text: An app calling itself an AI investor and promising steady daily profits is almost certainly a scam.

muc.title: Five common signs
muc.text: Common signs: a fixed promised return, pressure to deposit fast, fees to withdraw, and a private chat group.

muc.title: Nobody can predict prices for sure
muc.text: Nobody, AI included, can predict prices for sure. A promise of never losing money is exactly the trap.

muc.title: Let AI check the offer
muc.text: Paste the offer into a chatbot, with personal details removed, and ask for the warning signs. If you already paid, contact your bank and the police.

muc.title: Share it with family
muc.text: Send this to a family member and go through the five warning signs together.
